entries.title: Psalms 34:1
segments: ¶<Of David. When he made a change in his behaviour before Abimelech, who sent him away, and he went.> I will be blessing the Lord at all times; his praise will be ever in my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:2
segments: My soul will say great things of the Lord: the poor in spirit will have knowledge of it and be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 34:3
segments: O give praise to the Lord with me; let us be witnesses together of his great name.

entries.title: Psalms 34:4
segments: I was searching for the Lord, and he gave ear to my voice, and made me free from all my fears.

entries.title: Psalms 34:5
segments: Let your eyes be turned to him and you will have light, and your faces will not be shamed.

entries.title: Psalms 34:6
segments: This poor man's cry came before the Lord, and he gave him salvation from all his troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:7
segments: The angel of the Lord is ever watching over those who have fear of him, to keep them safe.

entries.title: Psalms 34:8
segments: By experience you will see that the Lord is good; happy is the man who has faith in him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:9
segments: Keep yourselves in the fear of the Lord, all you his saints; for those who do so will have no need of anything.

entries.title: Psalms 34:10
segments: The young lions are in need and have no food; but those who are looking to the Lord will have every good thing.

entries.title: Psalms 34:11
segments: ¶Come, children, give attention to me; I will be your teacher in the fear of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 34:12
segments: What man has a love of life, and a desire that his days may be increased so that he may see good?

entries.title: Psalms 34:13
segments: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from words of deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 34:14
segments: Be turned from evil, and do good; make a search for peace, desiring it with all your heart.

entries.title: Psalms 34:15
segments: The eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their cry.

entries.title: Psalms 34:16
segments: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to take away the memory of them from the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:17
segments: The cry of the upright comes before the Lord, and he takes them out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:18
segments: The Lord is near the broken-hearted; he is the saviour of those whose spirits are crushed down.

entries.title: Psalms 34:19
segments: Great are the troubles of the upright: but the Lord takes him safely out of them all.

entries.title: Psalms 34:20
segments: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.

entries.title: Psalms 34:21
segments: Evil will put an end to the sinner, and those who are haters of righteousness will come to destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 34:22
segments: The Lord will be the saviour of the souls of his servants, and no one who has faith in him will be put to shame.
